answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. The vine of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The saffron holds work receipts rather than names, so the zenith of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a factual sentences, no filler register, it stays short.
